Definition: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram
BiblicalUsage: Habakkuk closes his prayer with a note to the chief singer on his stringed instruments, and Hezekiah promises to sing his songs to the stringed instruments in the house of the LORD all his days.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the stringed instruments carry the prayers that words alone cannot: Habakkuk's trembling and Hezekiah's healing both end in song, and the music is the prayer going on after the words stop.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
